About this research & supporting sources

This site presents the table researched in this conversation. It is a fixed research snapshot, not a live university search or an exhaustive catalogue. Filters search only the 47 listed routes. No automatic date updates are configured. Shortlist selections are stored in this browser only. Named plans marked “Plan approval required” are candidates based on published components and structure rules, not guaranteed combinations. Selecting more subjects never combines unrelated degree rows into a fabricated route.

German-taught routes are flagged. Utrecht’s Economics degree is English taught; the Criminology minor’s language remains unverified. No suitable undergraduate Criminology minor in Germany was verified in this research. Role selections apply across every country. Awarding country is distinct from study country. Foreign-campus coverage is a targeted review, not an exhaustive global directory. Programme labels from older sources require 2027-cohort confirmation.
